import 'package:async/async.dart';

final word = RegExp(r'\w+');
// Don't SELECT * FROM users here.
/* Don't SELECT * FROM users
   or read jsonb here either. */

bool words(String text, int size, String pattern) {
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-dart
  final found = RegExp(r'a+b');
  final dynamic = RegExp(pattern);
  // ruleid: whole-row-sql-dart
  final query = 'SELECT * FROM users';
  final exists = 'SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM users)';
  final copy = 'INSERT INTO archive SELECT * FROM users';
  // ruleid: json-column-dart
  final key = "SELECT data->>'k' FROM users";
  // ruleid: bool-array-dart
  final seen = List<bool>.filled(size, false);
  // ruleid: in-process-cache-dart
  final cache = AsyncCache<int>(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  return query.isEmpty && copy.isEmpty && key.isEmpty && exists.isEmpty && found.hasMatch(text) && dynamic.hasMatch(text) && seen.isEmpty && cache.hashCode > 0;
}

Future<void> load(List<String> ids, Client client, Client users, Client blocks, Client orders, Stream<String> lines, Object context) async {
  for (final id in ids) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await client.get(id);
  }
  var cursor = await client.page('');
  while (cursor.isNotEmpty) {
    cursor = await client.page(cursor);
  }
  for (final id in ids) {
    await client.put(id);
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  }
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
  final first = await users.get('a');
  final second = await orders.get('b');
  final third = await client.get(second);
  print(third);
  final yes = await showDialog(context);
  final no = await showDialog(context);
  print(no);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
  final top = await blocks.get('a');
  final bottom = await blocks.get('b');
  print(no);
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-dart
  final left = await client.get('a');
  final right = await client.get('b');
  await for (final line in lines) {
    await client.put(line);
  }
  await for (final line in client.stream(
    'a',
  )) {
    await client.put(line);
  }
  print([first, third, yes, no, top, bottom, left, right]);
}
